text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Steel Flower - (built 1977) 38,460 dwt sold to U.S. buyers for $2 million.
Ocean Leader - (built 1981) 27,869 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $7.01 million at auction.
Trade Rich - (built 1983) 25,950 dwt sold to Malaysian buyers for $9.25 million.

TANKERS - Sibarde - (built 1976) 31,955 dwt sold to Italian buyers for $5.6 million. Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
